how_to_apply: Get the application form ("Format of Application"). It is attached to the advertisement and is also uploaded on the website. The form can be converted to Word format.
Fill in a separate form for each post, in the prescribed format only, in clear CAPITAL letters. Enter Advertisement No. 05/2026, the post, the department, and your category and qualifications.
Paste a colour photograph signed across. It must show your full face, both ears and neck in frontal view, with a neutral, non-smiling expression and open eyes directed at the camera.
Give details of two of these three identity documents: Aadhaar No., Voter Id or PAN. Also give an active e-mail ID and mobile number, which must stay in use until the final result is published.
If the fee applies to you, get a Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of ESIC Fund A/c No.1, payable at Varanasi. Enter its number, date, bank and branch in the form.
Email a scanned copy of the form, with the supporting documents and the filled checklist, to [email protected] before the date of interview.

Report at the venue on your department's interview date between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Bring the original application form, the supporting documents and the original Demand Draft (if the fee applies) for verification.
Venue: Office of Dean, 2nd Floor, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Pandeypur, Varanasi, U.P.-221002
The interview schedule does not list Accident & Emergency, ICU, Dental or Statistician, although these departments appear in the vacancy table.
The fee is paid by Demand Draft in favour of ESIC Fund A/c No.1, payable at Varanasi. The notice calls it the Interview Fee. Once paid, the fee will not be refunded under any circumstances.

The Selection Board will select candidates based on their academic credentials and their performance in the interview. The result will be displayed on www.esic.gov.in, and the offer of appointment will be sent by e-mail. Selected candidates must join as instructed in the offer of appointment. Candidates are given the interview provisionally, subject to a detailed scrutiny of their eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The broad-specialty table lists 11 Professor, 15 Associate Professor, 12 Assistant Professor and 41 Senior Resident vacancies, plus 2 virtual Senior Resident vacancies (marked *). There is also 1 Tutor vacancy (ST). That makes 79 posts in total. * This is virtual vacancy. The vacancies are provisional. They may increase or decrease according to the actual requirement for teaching and patient care. Reservation will follow Government of India guidelines issued from time to time. Reservation for PH (Divyangjan) candidates will follow GoI norms. Any candidate can be appointed against any unfilled vacant reserved category post for 44 days, with provision of possible extension. A candidate of the unreserved category can apply against EWS. EWS posts are not carried forward. If no EWS candidate is available, candidates of other categories may be allowed to apply provisionally. They will be considered for the post as UR candidates, and the selection will be on merit only. If no reserved category candidate is available for an advertised post, the vacancy may be filled for less than 45 days as a de-reserved seat. The EWS certificate must be in the format of Annexure-I of DoPT Office Memorandum No. 36039/1/2019-Estt (Res), dated 31.01.2019. The OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate must not be issued earlier than 01 (One) Year before the date of interview. It must be in the format for jobs in the Govt. of India, issued by an officer not below the rank of Sub-Divisional Officer or equivalent authority of the concerned State, for a Central Govt. job. content_sections.text: Pay and allowances follow OM no. Z-11012/51/2022-Med VI dated 08.12.2022. content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of these documents must be attached to the application form: Certificate of passing Class 10th (or its Admit Card) for date of birth All mark sheets, attempt certificate and degree certificate of MBBS All mark sheets, attempt certificate and degree certificate of MD/MS/DNB/other examination Valid EWS/OBC/EBC/SC/ST certificate in the format for Central Govt. jobs, when applicable State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated) Proof of publication(s), paper/poster presentations, certificates of training, and attendance at conferences, workshops or seminars, if any Experience certificate Recent passport-size photograph Relieving certificate from the previous employer, if applicable NOC from the current employer, if applicable Aadhaar Card Completion certificate of the ICMR/NMC-conducted Bio-medical research examination, if any Completion certificate of the NMC Revised/Basic Medical Education Workshop, if any Demand Draft of Rs. 500/- as the interview fee, if applicable These documents will be verified against the originals before the interview or before an offer of appointment is issued. The checklist at the end of the application form lists them, with a column to mark each as submitted or give the reason if not.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in ESIC Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 78 posts: 11 Professor, 15 Associate Professor, 12 Assistant Professor, 39 Senior Resident and 1 Tutor. The notice also lists 2 virtual Senior Resident vacancies, and the numbers may increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. When is the ESIC Varanasi walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 3 December 2026 for departments including Anatomy, Physiology, General Medicine and Pediatrics. It is on 4 December 2026 for departments including Anesthesiology, Pharmacology, Radiology, General Surgery and Chest, and for the Tutor post. Reporting time is 09:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the ESIC Varanasi interview venue?
faq.answer: The venue is the Office of Dean, 2nd Floor, ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Pandeypur, Varanasi, U.P.-221002. The interview is offline only.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed?
faq.answer: The qualification is as per NMC (MCI) guidelines as stipulated in Gazette Notification NO-CG-DL-E-05072025-264399 dated 30.06.2025. Candidates must also have up-dated NMC/State Medical Council registration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: As on the date of interview, the limit is 69 Years (Not Exceeding) for teaching faculty and up to 45 Years for Senior Residents.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for ESIC Varanasi faculty and Senior Residents?
faq.answer: The fixed basic pay is Rs. 1,23,100/- for Professor, Rs. 78,800/- for Associate Professor, and Rs. 67,700/- for both Assistant Professor and Senior Resident. Other allowances are paid as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 500/- for all other categories. It is Nil for SC/ST/ESIC (Regular Employee)/Female Candidate, Defence Ex-servicemen & PH Candidate. It is paid by Demand Draft in favour of ESIC Fund A/c No.1, payable at Varanasi, and is not refundable.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Email a scanned copy of the application form and supporting documents to [email protected] before the interview. On the interview day, bring the original form, the documents and the original Demand Draft (if the fee applies).

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The Selection Board will select candidates based on their academic credentials and their performance in the interview. The result will be displayed on www.esic.gov.in, and the offer of appointment will be sent by e-mail.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is for 01 (One) Year on contract basis, extendable up to three years, or until the age of 70, whichever is earlier. No PF, Pension, Gratuity, Seniority or Promotion is admissible.
